# stb

Single-file image libraries by Sean Barrett, vendored without changes.

| File | Version |
|---|---|
| `stb_image.h` | v2.30 |
| `stb_image_write.h` | v1.16 |

Source: [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) at commit `4e9b368bfc071e97206ea5c6adba68dd0cbf8897`.
License: MIT or public domain, at your choice; the text is at the end of each header.

`stb_impl.c` compiles both implementations once, as C.
